ABOUT PAT-AI
AI that thinks,
not just responds

PAT-AI is an Indian AI development group building deeply intelligent, privacy-first AI systems that work perfectly with or without internet. We believe the future of AI is personal, local, and human-aligned.

Our core philosophy: AI should work like a second version of yourself — understanding your context, learning your patterns, executing at your level of intelligence.

Every system we build connects to PAT_7 — our core AI brain — creating a unified ecosystem of intelligence across every domain.

PAT_7
Hybrid AI Brain · Personal Intelligence

PAT_7 is the brain of everything PAT-AI builds. A personal AI that runs on your machine, calling on cloud models for heavier compute when it needs to. Not a tool. A second version of you.

What it is

A hybrid personal AI assistant designed to think the way you think, learn your patterns, and execute work at your level. Version 1 is complete: a voice-controlled research and information-gathering platform — internet-connected, pulling and displaying analytical data in a war-room style view. Voice control is in, but it's command-triggered rather than continuously listening. Version 2 is now in the assembly and testing stage, after data collection and model training wrapped up.

You speak to it. It understands you — your shortcuts, your domain language, your habits. The more you use it, the sharper it gets. Everything stays on your machine.

◈
Voice Interface

Three voice triggers — wake, attention, and shutdown. Speaker verified. Listens throughout your session so you can redirect mid-task naturally.

◉
Adaptive Intelligence

Learns from every correction you make. Maps your phrases to your intent. Understands your domain better with every session.

◎
Project Memory

Every project gets its own memory. PAT_7 remembers what you worked on, decisions made, and picks up exactly where you left off.

▣
Dual Output

Speaks short summaries. Full responses appear on screen simultaneously. Voice for awareness, screen for depth.

Where PAT_7 is going
  • →Assembling and testing version 2's multi-agent orchestration
  • →Expanding to data analysis, software development, architecture design and IoT control
  • →Refining the local/cloud handoff for real-time response speeds
  • →Deeper learning — PAT_7 begins to anticipate your needs, not just respond to them
  • →The core that powers Darshan_3 and Defender_9

◆ PROTOTYPE BUILT
DARSHAN_3
Vision AI · Assistive Hardware · PAT_7 Integrated

Darshan_3 was born from a real moment — watching a blind couple struggle to cross a road. That became a mission: give vision to those without it, through AI. Works perfectly without internet, anywhere on earth.

What it is

Smart spectacles with onboard vision AI that detects obstacles, potholes, people, and hazards in real time. PAT_7 speaks the guidance directly into your ear.

The first prototype is already built and running — currently using a mobile camera to validate the detection and guidance system. The hardware form factor comes next.

Designed for the visually impaired. Open to anyone who wants it.

◈
Real-Time Detection

Identifies obstacles, hazards, and potholes in your path as you move. High-confidence detections trigger immediate voice alerts through PAT_7.

◉
Voice Navigation

PAT_7 guides you through your path — clear, calm, real-time instructions through a paired earpiece. No screen. No phone needed.

◎
Works Without Internet

The vision AI runs entirely on the device. Works in any environment — rural roads, underground stations, anywhere.

▣
Charging Case

The spectacles charge wirelessly in their case when not in use — always ready when you need them.

Where Darshan_3 is going
  • →Move from mobile camera prototype to dedicated spectacle hardware with onboard chip
  • →Dual camera integration for better detection in low light and all conditions
  • →Deeper PAT_7 integration — context-aware navigation, landmark memory
  • →Expand detection — steps, slopes, moving vehicles, road crossings
  • →Miniaturize and refine for daily all-day wear comfort

◎ IN DEVELOPMENT
DEFENDER_9
Cybersecurity AI · 4 Module System · PAT_7 Integrated

Defender_9 is PAT-AI’s cybersecurity arm. It watches your systems, reads your code, and defends against threats — automatically, intelligently, and without needing to be online to function.

What it is

A 4-module AI system with two core objectives — finding vulnerabilities in source code before attackers do, and monitoring live systems in real time to detect and respond to threats as they happen.

Orchestrated by PAT_7, Defender_9 becomes your AI security analyst. You can query it by voice, get threat summaries, and let it act autonomously on your behalf.

Data collection is complete. The intelligence is being built on top of it now.

◈
Code Vulnerability Scan

Reads your source code and identifies security vulnerabilities, injection points, and unsafe patterns before they can be exploited.

◉
Live System Monitoring

Watches your websites, applications, and AI systems in real time. Flags anomalies and intrusion attempts as they happen.

◎
Active Defence

When a threat is confirmed, Defender_9 responds — isolating the issue and applying countermeasures without waiting for manual input.

▣
Works Without Internet

All threat intelligence and analysis runs locally. Protects your systems even in air-gapped or restricted environments.

Where Defender_9 is going
  • →Vulnerability detection engine built on top of the collected dataset
  • →Live monitoring module for real-time surveillance of active systems
  • →Active response module — autonomous threat mitigation without human input
  • →Full PAT_7 voice integration — query your security status, get briefings, issue commands
  • →Expand coverage to APIs, AI models, IoT networks and beyond
